item.description: Looking to check how many Flex Dollars you have left or how many meal swipes you have left for the week? item.description: Date: Monday, October 26, 2026 - Fri , October 30, 2026 (all day) - Phalanx was founded in 1912 to recognize Rensselaer students who distinguish themselves in the areas of Leadership, Service, and Devotion to the Alma Mater. item.title: Registration is now open for Ensemble Nonlinear
item.description: Ensemble Nonlinear is RPI’s 21st century experiential musical performance ensemble. Ensemble Nonlinear allows students to participate as performers in the ensemble (ARTS 2600; 1 credit), as well as researchers, composers, and creatives (ARTS 4600/6600; 4 credits) building instruments and networked audio environments. To learn more, please join Dr. Rob Hamilton at a special information session on Friday October 30, at 4:00 pm in SAGE 2510.

item.title: Atomic Habits: Division of Human Resources: Book Discussion Series
item.description: This session is designed to facilitate an open discussion of Atomic Habits by James Clear. Participants will reflect on the book’s key concepts, share perspectives, and discuss practical ways to apply its principles to personal and professional growth. No matter your goals, Atomic Habits offers a proven framework for improving–every day.

item.title: RPI Faculty Quick Learn Webinar: Tips for Planning Your Condensed Course
item.description:
Date: Monday, November 9, 2026 12:30 PM - 1:00 PM - The Planning Your Condensed Course webinar is meant to assist instructors teaching short semester courses in planning and presenting their course material in innovative, effective, and carefully considered ways. In this webinar we will offer quick tips on best practices in condensing coursework. Please register using the Event URL in the See section of the calendar event.
